description: Defines data structures, constants, and enums for disk cache block file format, including index headers, cache entries, and LRU data management.

classes.name: IndexHeader
classes.description: Header structure for the master index file, containing metadata and cache state information.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents the entire index file, including header and hash table.

classes.name: EntryStore
classes.description: Main structure for a cache entry, including key, hash, data pointers, and metadata.

classes.name: RankingsNode
classes.description: Stores LRU and modification info for cache entries.

methods.name: IndexHeader
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the index header structure.
